# Three.js rectangular area-light support

`RectAreaLightUniformsLib.js` is from Three.js 0.160.1, matching the bundled renderer:
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.1/examples/jsm/lights/RectAreaLightUniformsLib.js

The only source change is the import path, from `three` to `../three.module.js`.
Covered by the Three.js MIT license in `../THREE-LICENSE.txt`. The original source
retains its attribution for the precomputed LTC shading data.
